title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_understanding_the_digital_world_by_brian_w_kernighan_0bboj (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_understanding_the_digital_world_by_brian_w_kernighan_0bboj' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but complete remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system due to potential persistent control by an attacker.
